title: Clearing-Time Increment to the Direct Card Limit
content:
**Rule.** The clearing-time increment raises the direct card limit on a Real Estate Service Contracts buyer-only order by the calendar days from the payment date to the expected closing date on the order, so that the card payment settles before closing.

| Calendar days from the payment date to the expected closing date | Clearing-time increment |
|---|---|
| 14 or more | $100.00 |
| 7 or more but fewer than 14 | $50.00 |
| fewer than 7 | nothing |

It is added once to the direct card limit, before the card payments already taken on the order are deducted from the limit and the limit is floored at zero.

## Boundaries (hypothetical payment made on 1 June)

| Expected closing date on the order | Days | Increment |
|---|---|---|
| 7 June | 6 | nothing |
| 8 June | 7 | $50.00 |
| 14 June | 13 | $50.00 |
| 15 June | 14 | $100.00 |

The expected closing date read is the one shown on the order on the payment date.
